1404| def classify_failure(subtask: dict[str, Any], outcome: Any) -> str:
1405|     """Map a rejected subtask to a control-loop failure branch.
1406| 
1407|     * ``transient`` — timeout / model-network error / crash / lock conflict and
1408|       attempts remain: retry the SAME subtask (attempt+1), plan unchanged.
1409|     * ``structural`` — forced: the executor was blocked (no tools at all), the
1410|       workspace was rejected, or the attempt budget is exhausted.
1411|     * ``rewrite_remaining`` — otherwise (wrong approach). The rewrite proposal
1412|       is still diffed: if it changes steps/deps/criteria it is escalated to
1413|       ``structural`` by the control loop.
1414|     """
1415|     stop = getattr(outcome, "stop_reason", None) or ""
1416|     error = getattr(outcome, "error", None) or ""

1499| def reset_subtask_for_retry(subtask: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
1500|     """Transient failure: same node, bump attempt, clear running fields."""
1501|     s = dict(subtask)
1502|     s["status"] = SUBTASK_PENDING
1503|     s["attempt_number"] = int(s.get("attempt_number") or 0)  # bumped when leased
1504|     s["error"] = None
1505|     s["stop_reason"] = ""
1506|     s["result_summary"] = ""
1507|     s["result_full"] = ""
1508|     s["finished_at"] = None
1509|     s["finished_seq"] = None
1510|     # Keep acceptance_evidence from the failed attempt for diagnostics.
1511|     return s

1103|     plan = state["plan"]
1104|     sub = P.find_subtask(plan, state.get("current_id"))
1105|     outcome = state["last_outcome"]
1106|     assert sub is not None
1107|     legacy = P.is_legacy(plan)
1108|     if (outcome.status == agent_executor.STATUS_CANCELLED
1109|             or outcome.stop_reason == getattr(agent_executor, "STOP_CANCELLED", "cancelled")):
1110|         sub["status"] = P.SUBTASK_CANCELLED
1111|         sub["verify_note"] = outcome.summary or "用户取消"
1112|         sub["error"] = outcome.error
1113|         sub["stop_reason"] = outcome.stop_reason
1114|         sub["finished_at"] = utc_now()
